what: serving speed of the API (backlog item 13); not accuracy

software.torch_threads_note: read in the client process; the server uses the same default

server: scripts/bench_app.py: app/api/main.py's create_app, one uvicorn worker, rate limiter opened wide
conditions: client and server share the same machine's CPUs; every request opens a new connection (urllib sends Connection: close); the API runs each request in a worker thread, so concurrent requests compute in parallel and compete for the CPUs; CPU is measured per level (server_cpu_cores_used: the server process's CPU seconds over wall time, all its threads; machine_cpu_busy_share: all CPUs, the load generator included)
image: one synthetic 448x448 JPEG, sent repeatedly; 10 warm-up requests not counted

bottleneck.evidence: at 20 users the server used 3.95 of 4 cores and the machine was 99.6% busy
bottleneck.rule: CPU-bound when the server used at least 85% of the cores or the machine was at least 90% busy at the busiest level (the load generator runs on the same machine)
